_comment: API list prices in USD per 1,000,000 tokens, as [input, output]. This is DATA and not code for one reason: prices change on the vendor's schedule, not ours, and a stale table does not fail — it silently reports a wrong number for every case in the ledger. Update it when a vendor changes list price or you add a model. Cache-read/write rates are derived from the input rate in code. `anthropic_models` is what cost_report.py sums for the Anthropic model ledger; `openai_compatible_models` is what the alternate backend (DeepSeek/Kimi/local) uses and can also be overridden per deployment via HARNESS_MODEL_PRICE. Third-party API credits (FOFA/urlscan/Censys/IntelX/SerpApi) are a SEPARATE ledger in MEMORY/api_usage.jsonl and are not priced here.

anthropic_models._comment: Anthropic model id -> [input_usd_per_mtok, output_usd_per_mtok]. Keep the id exactly as the API reports it, since lookups are by that string.

openai_compatible_models._comment: Model id -> [input, output] for the OpenAI-compatible backend (DeepSeek and friends). Approximations at standard price; override per deployment with the HARNESS_MODEL_PRICE env var for accuracy or for a negotiated rate.

harness_tier_model_map._comment: Harness tier (haiku/sonnet/opus) -> the concrete model the alternate backend should call. Default keeps every tier on a tool-capable model; override per deployment with HARNESS_MODEL_MAP.
